transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Rebecca, we're evaluating MPLS vs SD-WAN for our multi-site architecture. I need someone who really understands the trade-offs.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely. The key consideration is predictable performance versus cost flexibility. MPLS gives you guaranteed bandwidth and latency, while SD-WAN offers dynamic path selection but with less predictability. What's driving your evaluation?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Primarily cost reduction, but we can't sacrifice performance for our trading applications. Sub-5ms latency requirements.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: For trading with sub-5ms requirements, I'd recommend our hybrid approach - MPLS for critical trading paths with SD-WAN overlay for other traffic. This gives you guaranteed performance where needed while reducing overall costs by 30-40%.
